featured_reviews.name: yushy (yushy)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Im a photographer from London,
I recently entrusted a film development service in Mumbai with my precious rolls of film, representing months of hard work and creativity during my time working there from London. Unfortunately, the experience has left me bitterly disappointed and infuriated.

These films were not just random snapshots but weeks of hard work. When I handed over my films, I expected professionalism, care, and competence. What I got instead was nothing short of negligence.

To my horror, the developed films were riddled with watermarks, uneven processing, and in some cases, completely ruined frames. with the service giving me a half-hearted explanation about "issues with the film itself or my camera is not working properly"—a claim that felt more like an excuse to cover up their poor handling. The lack of accountability only added to my frustration. I was left with nothing but excuses.

This debacle has cost me irreplaceable creative work and potential opportunities to showcase my project. What stings the most is that I trusted this service with something so irreplaceable, and their carelessness obliterated months of dedication.

For any fellow artists or photographers considering similar services in Mumbai, I strongly urge you to think twice. This experience has been a painful lesson in ensuring your work is only entrusted to those who truly respect the medium and the effort behind it.

I sincerely hope the service takes this feedback seriously, but unfortunately, the damage to my work—and my trust—cannot be undone.
